Subject: Next steps & kickoff: Redwood evaluation for Finova – scheduling demo/kickoff

Hi Olivia —

Thanks again for taking the time today to walk through Finova's primary inference workloads and the goals you outlined. Quick recap from our side:

- Objective: run a 4-week evaluation focused on customer-facing summarization and latency-sensitive chat flows.
- Success criteria: match current QA quality on top-3 intents (precision >= 92%), median p95 latency < 250ms for 512-token requests, and cost/unit within 20% of current baseline.
- Trial deliverables: evaluation environment, prompt set and initial evals, weekly syncs, and a final runbook with performance/cost recommendations.

I've attached a draft trial plan (trial_plan_v1.pdf) with proposed milestones and a starter prompt set. Proposed next step: schedule an evaluation kickoff that combines a short technical deep dive (30–45m) and a calendar alignment session to confirm measurement points and access.

Can you do either of these slots?
- Wed, Feb 18, 10:00–10:45 AM PT
- Thu, Feb 19, 11:00–11:45 AM PT
- Fri, Feb 20, 9:00–9:45 AM PT

If none work, drop a couple of times that do and we’ll adapt. I’ve CC'd Aditya (lead AE) and Dev (solutions engineer) so we can confirm attendees and prep the prompt sets.

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0189

Marissa —

Appreciate the recap and the draft plan. The objectives and success criteria look good; I especially like the explicit latency and cost targets. Our security team also asked whether we can review a filled security questionnaire before the kickoff — happy to follow your suggested sequence if you think the questionnaire can be shared after we confirm the kickoff time.

Of the slots above, Thu, Feb 19 at 11:00 AM PT works best for our core team. Attendees from Finova: myself, Daniel Park (Platform Engineer), and Maya Singh (Security).

A couple of asks so we can prep on our side:
- Can you include an example prompt set (a few representative prompts) in the kickoff materials?
- Can we add a short (10–15m) segment to confirm data access and redaction approach?

Thanks — we’ll block Thu 19 at 11:00 AM PT tentatively.
